{{Quote|Come to the Makeb system, and tell no one.|Darth Marr|<ref name="Isotope-5" />}}
The '''Makeb system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Aida sector/Legends|Aida sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> on the edge of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], far from any major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. The system's [[Makeb's sun|yellow sun]] was orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], which was not discovered by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] until the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Keylander Station]] was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the orbit of Makeb.
